route: /style-board/ (the style board: module process:list, longest and shortest copy, photos as grey frames)

findings.issue: Each step title ("Scale and trial print", "A4 approval options" …) is set smaller than the text under it: the title is about 7.3 px per character against about 8.1 px for the regular text, which bold type should outweigh. So the bold names shrink beside their own descriptions and the step hierarchy is upside down.
findings.reference: The competitor sets each step name ("Custom Designs", "Ready Designs", "Mix n' Match") clearly larger than its body text, bold, with the text below it in a smaller size.
findings.fix: In reference.css, remove the `--size-subheading: 1.0625rem` override on .block--process (line 271). That lets .point-list__title take the template's own subheading size, which sits above body size. Keep font-weight: 700. Don't set a fixed font-size on the title.

findings.issue: On phones the step titles are again smaller than their descriptions ("Scale and trial print" is about 153 px wide for 21 bold characters, while "We send you digital mock-ups so" is about 263 px for 31 regular ones), so the descriptions outweigh the step names.
findings.reference: The competitor's step name is always the larger, bolder line above its text.
findings.fix: The same change as on desktop: remove the 1.0625rem --size-subheading override on .block--process so the step title is sized above body text at every width.

findings.issue: The section still has no heading. It opens only on the body-size lead "Quality checks at every stage of an order", so its left column looks nearly empty, and on phones the list starts with no title at all.
findings.reference: The competitor's process list always opens with a large H2 ("3 Ways to Handover") above its lead, as m7 does here with "Mock-ups, Strike-offs and Sample Approval".
findings.fix: Site Factory should supply a heading for overview-steps (for example "Quality Checks at Every Stage") so the block renders its h2 above the lead.

findings.issue: A step's title sits right on top of its description with no gap ("Scale and trial print" / "We send you digital mock-ups…"). The title's margin-bottom of 0.5rem was lost when the list rules were rewritten.
findings.reference: The competitor leaves a small gap (about 8–10 px) between each step name and its description.

findings.issue: At 1440 px the step descriptions still run about 90 characters a line ("We send you digital mock-ups so you can approve the scale, and we turn strike-offs around"), over the 80ch limit for running text. The six-step list also ends on open space with no closing rule under step 06.
findings.reference: The competitor's step text keeps to about 65–75 characters a line, and its list ends with a thin rule under the last step, as it starts with one above the first.
findings.fix: In reference.css, set max-width: 70ch on .block--process .point-list__items[data-numbered] > .point-list__item > :not(.point-list__title). Also add border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 18%, transparent) to .block--process .point-list__items[data-numbered] > .point-list__item:last-child.
